description: Enterprise Accounts Payable Policy Ruleset & Surcharge Allowances

policies.name: Standard Logistics & Freight Allowance
policies.description: Unbundled freight, shipping, LTL transport, and liftgate charges are allowable adjustments if indicated in invoice lines or notes.

policies.name: Fuel Surcharge & Handling Adjustment
policies.description: Fuel surcharges and hazardous material handling up to 10% are permitted for logistics and manufacturing vendors.

policies.name: Early Settlement & Volume Credit
policies.description: Pre-agreed vendor volume rebates, promotional credits, and early settlement deductions (e.g. 2/10 Net 30) are approved reductions.

policies.name: Compound & Municipal Tax Buffer
policies.description: Permits up to 1.5% discrepancy arising from local municipal sales taxes, county surcharges, or fractional cent rounding.
